Straight-leg trousers, mid-rise, full length to the ankle, matching the blazer, medium grey (#6B7078), textured wool-blend
Long-sleeve V-neck blouse, relaxed cut, hip-skimming length to wear untucked or half-tucked, soft ivory (#F3EBDD), silk crepe
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather
Medium hoop earrings, slim and polished, silver (#C0C0C0), sterling silver
Structured tote bag, top handles, burgundy (#6D2E3A), grained leather

Why this outfit works: The grey suit is the centerpiece you asked for, and its matching textured wool gives a polished, office-ready look suited to a neat business setting. The ivory blouse brings light close to your face and sets off your deep skin tone and dark hair, while the burgundy bag adds a rich autumn accent. The silver earrings pick up the cool tone of the grey and add a subtle shine. Black ankle boots keep the outfit comfortable and grounded for a full day at work."}
